osm_parse — DRIVE japan op

• Data kinds: any → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.osm_parse(source, *, origin=None) -> 'Dict[str, object]' (to call the implementation directly, import drivejapan; drivejapan.osm_parse(source, *, origin=None) -> 'Dict[str, object]'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("osm_parse"))

Usage

Reads OSM XML (a string or a file path) and projects the nodes to local planar coordinates [m].

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

返り値 {"origin": (lat0, lon0), "nodes": {id: {"xy": (x, y), "lat", "lon", "tags": {}}}, "ways": [{"id", "nodes": [id], "tags": {}}], "bbox": (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)(<bounds> があればそれ、無ければ節点の範囲), "n_nodes", "n_ways"}。origin が None なら <bounds> の中心(無ければ節点の平均)。<nd ref> が未知の節点を指す way はその節点を落とす(件数を n_dangling に)。Raises ValueError: XML でない、<osm> でない、節点が 1 つも無い。
